specification.range_semantics: closed validity ranges; score-bin lower bounds are inclusive and upper bounds are exclusive
specification.invalid_numeric_policy: nonfinite, out-of-range, and otherwise invalid numeric predictor values use the predictor-specific frozen missing branch
specification.public_api_units: uf_bw_percent is expressed in percentage points; enter 3.5 for 3.5%, not 0.035
specification.score_source: fixed published Nadir90 five-variable point rule
specification.reported_rule_scope: code-only implementation of the published fixed Nadir90 five-variable point rule and its probability mapping; model fitting, variable selection, and private-data analyses are out of scope

semantic_alignment.history_event: prior-session post-start nadir SBP below 90 mm Hg

outcome.name: Nadir90
outcome.definition: current-session intradialytic nadir systolic blood pressure below 90 mm Hg

csv_encoding.minimum_class_support: at least one event and one non-event

source_outcome.name: Nadir90
source_outcome.definition: prior-session post-start nadir systolic blood pressure below 90 mm Hg

history_feature.cold_start_rule: no prior eligible dialysis session is an observed count of 0, not missing
history_feature.left_censoring_rule: retain the observed prior-event count, including 0, when less than 7 days of linked history are available; do not impute unavailable pre-cohort events

features.label: prior Nadir90 events in the preceding 7 days
features.cold_start_rule: no prior eligible dialysis session is an observed count of 0, not missing

features.label: planned ultrafiltration divided by body weight

probability_maps.interpretation_boundary: The bundled lookup is the fixed published probability mapping. Local calibration must be assessed before deployment in other institutions or periods.

csv_validation_contract.optional_patient_identifier: an arbitrary column selected explicitly with --patient-id COLUMN
csv_validation_contract.extra_columns: allowed but ignored; only their count is reported
csv_validation_contract.feature_policy: missing and invalid feature cells remain in the validation cohort and use the predictor-specific frozen missing branch
csv_validation_contract.outcome_policy: declared missing-token outcome rows are excluded from metrics and counted; every nonmissing outcome must be finite binary 0/1 Nadir90, and eligible rows must contain at least one event and one non-event
csv_validation_contract.patient_id_policy: only a column explicitly selected with --patient-id COLUMN is used; it may have any name and must be complete among outcome-eligible rows; without --patient-id no bootstrap is run, and no row bootstrap is substituted

uf_unit_warning.trigger: median of valid observed uf_bw_percent values < 0.5 or > 10 percentage points
uf_unit_warning.meaning: possible unit or source-field mapping problem

validation_metrics.auroc: area under the receiver operating characteristic curve
validation_metrics.auprc: average precision, used as area under the precision-recall curve
validation_metrics.observed_expected: observed event count divided by summed predicted probability
validation_metrics.joint_calibration: unpenalized logistic outcome ~ intercept + slope * logit(predicted probability)
validation_metrics.delta: fixed-slope intercept offset solving sum(outcome) = sum(expit(logit(predicted probability) + delta)); prediction slope held at one
validation_metrics.fixed_slope_intercept_offset: descriptive alias of delta retained in point metrics
